Велик.face: angular Slavic features, strong jaw, high cheekbones, weathered by journey
Велик.hair: dark brown, shoulder-length, often tied back with leather cord
Велик.eyes: deep blue, intense contemplative gaze, carries weight of knowledge

clothing.daily: linen tunic, leather belt, wool cloak with fur-lined collar, sturdy boots
clothing.ceremonial: embroidered deep blue robe, silver torc necklace, runic amulet

Велик.mannerisms: confident posture, deliberate gestures, contemplative stillness before action
Велик.movement: graceful but grounded, warrior's awareness, fluid transitions between rest and readiness

Учитель.face: deeply lined, serene, eyes that see beyond surface reality
Учитель.eyes: pale blue, almost luminous, conveying infinite patience and ancient knowledge
Учитель.build: tall, thin but dignified, upright posture despite age

clothing.daily: simple white linen robe, leather sandals, rope belt
clothing.ceremonial: flowing white and gold robes, crystal-inlaid staff, sacred symbols embroidered

Учитель.mannerisms: minimal movement, every gesture deliberate and meaningful, profound stillness
Учитель.movement: effortless, as if floating slightly above ground, ancient grace

Световит.face: strong Nordic-Slavic features, weathered but noble, scar across left eyebrow
Световит.eyes: steel grey, piercing, eyes of a leader and strategist
Световит.build: broad-shouldered, powerful, warrior's build softened by years of wisdom

clothing.daily: dark leather armor over linen, fur-trimmed cloak, sturdy boots
clothing.ceremonial: ornate dark blue and silver armor, cloak of office, ceremonial sword

Световит.mannerisms: commanding presence, measured speech, decisive when action is needed
Световит.movement: purposeful, authoritative, warrior's economy of motion
